SUNKEN VALLEY FARM BUSINESS PLAN
EXECUTIVE
SUMMARY
Sunken Valley Farm is an innovative, eco-friendly agricultural startup
focused on providing sustainable organic produce to hospitality
businesses. Our mission is to create a farm-to-table supply chain that
minimizes waste and maximizes quality. We are seeking $500,000 in
funding to expand operations, implement advanced hydroponic
farming systems, and scale production to meet increasing demand.
COMPANY
OVERVIEW
Sunken Valley Farm was founded with the goal of revolutionizing local
food sourcing by offering a direct-to-business organic supply chain.
Our vision is to become the leading sustainable farm provider for
boutique hotels, restaurants, and luxury resorts nationwide. By
partnering with high-end hospitality establishments, we aim to create a
seamless farm-to-table experience that benefits both businesses and
consumers.
MARKET
OPPORTUNITY
The farm-to-table market is growing rapidly, with consumer demand
for locally sourced organic food increasing by 12% annually. Hotels,
resorts, and restaurants are prioritizing partnerships with sustainable
suppliers to meet guest expectations. This shift presents a major
opportunity for Sunken Valley Farm to establish long-term contracts
with hospitality providers, leveraging the growing emphasis on
eco-conscious dining experiences.

SUNKEN VALLEY FARM BUSINESS PLAN
PRODUCTS &
SERVICES
Offerings include:
• Organic produce supply: high-quality fruits, vegetables, and
herbs grown using sustainable practices.
• Custom farming solutions: tailored crop production based on
hotel and restaurant menu needs.
• Sustainable packaging: 100% compostable and eco-friendly
packaging solutions for delivered goods.
• On-site consulting: assisting hospitality businesses in
developing their own in-house herb gardens and sustainability
programs.
• Farm tours & educational workshops: partnering with resorts to
offer immersive sustainability experiences to guests.
COMPANY
STRUCTURE
Sunken Valley Farm is a privately held LLC, founded by a team of
agricultural experts and sustainability advocates. The leadership team
includes:
JI-MIN AN KALLE PERSSON JORDAN MITCHELL
CEO COO Head of Partnerships

SUNKEN VALLEY FARM BUSINESS PLAN
OPERATIONAL
PLAN
To meet demand and ensure a steady supply of premium organic
produce, Sunken Valley Farm will:
1. Establish hydroponic and vertical farming facilities to maximize
production capacity.
2. Implement technology-driven inventory and distribution
systems for seamless order fulfillment.
3. Develop strategic partnerships with logistics providers to
optimize delivery efficiency.
4. Hire key personnel specializing in farm management and
hospitality partnerships.
MARKETING
& SALES
STRATEGY
• Direct B2B outreach: targeting high-end hotels, resorts, and
restaurants to secure long-term contracts.
• Sustainability branding: emphasizing our zero-waste
commitment and premium organic quality.
• Partnership development: collaborating with eco-conscious
hospitality brands to enhance visibility.
• Digital marketing: leveraging SEO, content marketing, and
social media to build brand awareness.
COMPETITIVE
ADVANTAGE
Sunken Valley Farm specializes in premium organic produce with a
strong commitment to sustainability. Our zero-waste farming methods
and local sourcing strategy set us apart from competitors, ensuring
that hospitality businesses receive the freshest ingredients with
minimal environmental impact. By offering tailored farming solutions
and exclusive partnerships, we provide a fully customizable
farm-to-table experience for high-end establishments.

RISK
ASSESSMENT
Potential challenges and mitigation strategies:
• Supply chain disruptions: establish multiple sourcing points
and backup suppliers.
• Market competition: focus on differentiation through
sustainability and premium quality.
• Operational scalability: gradual expansion with controlled
scaling to prevent overextension.

SUNKEN VALLEY FARM BUSINESS PLAN

• Exploring acquisition opportunities with major hospitality

• Potential IPO or equity-based investment to scale operations
globally.
